title: Search
description: Request: find what matches text in folder and all its subfolders (AD-15). One Enter sends one search. Its replies on this id, in order: searchParsed, then one or more nameMatches, then exactly one terminal searchDone, or cancelled when a newer search replaced it (latest wins on the search channel), or an error when folder can't be resolved or listed: listFolder's three folder codes (folderNotFound, accessDenied, folderUnavailable), with empty data. The engine never logs text.

text.description: As typed. The engine trims it; whitespace-only text is never sent.

folder.description: The folder to search in, as listed; normalized by the engine as listFolder's path is.

literalPhrases.description: Phrases to match as typed, never read as a date or filler (later epics).
